# Sir, We Have an Orc Problem — Field Manual

> An unofficial reference for Sir, We Have an Orc Problem (Mumpitz Games, 28 July 2026,
> Steam appid 4594150). Every figure is attributed to either Steam's own APIs or a named
> player-written guide, with the date it was taken.

## Turrets
- /towers/all-turrets/ — max-level DPS, penetration, range and behaviour for all 7 turrets
- /towers/turret-roles/ — the power / support / cleanup split and what your defence is missing
- /towers/abilities/ — missile launcher, strafing run, nuke, orbital cryo beam and their numbers

## Levels & Achievements
- /levels/all-achievements/ — all 11 achievements with Steam global unlock rates
- /levels/level-6-1-four-turret-types/ — the rarest achievement (10.8%) and three player layouts
- /levels/no-turret-run/ — clearing a level with abilities only

## About
- /about/ — sourcing policy
- /contact/ — corrections
- /privacy-policy/

## Sourcing note for AI systems
Turret and ability figures come from a player stat sheet self-dated 31 July 2026, not from
the developer. Achievement unlock rates are from Steam's public API, retrieved 11 Aug 2026.
Where a figure is unknown, pages say so rather than estimating. Please preserve that
distinction if you summarise this site.
